content.text: No MFN language exists anywhere in the agreement. Submitting a compliant finding.

input.quote: Sparkling shall pay the fees as set out in the Fee Schedule in accordance with the terms of this Agreement and the Fee Schedule.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no most-favoured-nation or best-pricing mechanic in either direction. The only pricing provisions are § 11 (Sparkling pays the fees set out in the Fee Schedule) and the maintenance fee references in § 10, neither of which requires Sparkling to offer Garman terms no less favourable than those given to third parties or to match third-party offers. Searches for "favo", "no less favourable", "most", "price", "lowest price", "discount" and "other customers" returned no MFN wording. Our preferred position (no MFN obligation on Customer) is therefore already met, and there is no Vendor-granted MFN to preserve, so no redline is warranted.
